corrections.old_text: ኝ እንደሆነ ። ፪ ፥ ነገ ፥ ፲፱ ፥ ፲፩ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ኝ እንደሆነ ። ፩ ፥ ነገ ፥ ፲፱ ፥ ፲፬ ።
corrections.reason: The printed biblical reference is ፩ ነገ ፲፱ ፥ ፲፬ (1 Kings 19:14), where ፩ and ፬ were misread as ፪ and ፩.
The 1st-order Fidel ተ in the pronoun እናንተ was misread as 6th-order ት.

corrections.old_text: ሉቃ ፱ ፴፮ ፥ ፲፪ ፰ ። ፪ጢሞ ፪
corrections.corrected_text: ሉቃ ፱ ፳፮ ፥ ፲፪ ፰ ። ፪ጢሞ ፪
corrections.reason: The canonical cross-reference is Luke 9:26 (ሉቃ ፱ ፳፮); the numeral ፳ (20) was misread as ፴ (30).
The 6th-order prefix ስ in ስበላ (matching ስጠጣ and L28 ስበላ) was misread as 1st-order ሰ.
